name: 30728 · Lafayette, GA
findings: ZIP 30728 (Lafayette) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30728 (Lafayette) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30728 (Lafayette) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 19% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 66% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
